# Bind

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Has the kernel set an event bit when a port, task or space needs attention.

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0A` SVC_BIND | `EVENT_PORT (3), EVENT_TASK (4), EVENT_SPACE (5)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err Bind(EventType type, Handle ev_handle, Handle target, uint32_t bit);
```

**Registers:** `(type, event, target, bit) -> r0 status`

`type`

`target`

The bit is set when

EVENT_PORT

port

a caller is queued with nobody receiving

EVENT_TASK

task

the task exits or faults

EVENT_SPACE

space

the space has no live tasks left

If the condition already holds, the bit is set at once. The bit then belongs to the kernel: Signal() may not set it. An object accepts at most four bindings.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | in | EVENT_PORT, EVENT_TASK or EVENT_SPACE. |
| `ev_handle` | in | Event handle with PERM_CNTL. |
| `target` | in | [Handle](../types.md#handle) of the matching kind, with PERM_WAIT. |
| `bit` | in | Bit number, 0-30. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | A handle is not live. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `ev_handle` is not an event, or `target` is the wrong kind. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `ev_handle` lacks PERM_CNTL, or `target` lacks PERM_WAIT. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `bit` is out of range, or `type` is unknown. |
| [`ERR_DEAD`](../errors.md#err_dead) | The event or the port has died. |
| [`ERR_NOMEM`](../errors.md#err_nomem) | `target` already has four bindings. |
